chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 188: Ji Ning Joins the Yinglong Guard - The Crimson Dragon Mountains
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Mu Northson arrive at the Crimson Dragon Mountains to join the Yinglong Guard. They face cold bureaucracy, witness the terrifying scale of the state's power, and prepare for the deadly Yanshan trial.

og_description: Ji Ning bids farewell and heads to the Crimson Dragon Mountains, where the cold, ruthless authority of the Imperial Yinglong Guard is on full display.
